title: DeskWand Bot deployment configuration
description: Versioned non-secret runtime configuration shared by the Worker and the deployment client. Additional top-level properties (for example advanced settings introduced by a newer client) are accepted and preserved verbatim by readers. schemaVersion is required and only version 1 is supported; a different version must be rejected rather than interpreted loosely.

schemaVersion.description: Configuration schema version. Readers reject any other value.

locale.description: Language the bot uses for fixed owner-facing text and replies. Absent means zh.

approvalMode.description: How tasks handle write actions. autonomous runs them directly (only tools the owner marked as require-approval and bot rules changes ask); reviewed sends them through the model reviewer first. Absent means autonomous.

Owner.description: Telegram users allowed to talk to the bot. An empty list is valid and disables Telegram access; it never falls back to a built-in owner. Additional properties are preserved for round-trip.

items.description: Positive Telegram user ID representable exactly as a JavaScript safe integer.

Models.description: Model chosen for each role. Additional role entries and advanced settings are accepted and preserved for round-trip.

ModelRef.description: Provider and model ID understood by the existing pi-ai adapters. Additional provider-specific fields are accepted and preserved for round-trip; no new base URL or credential field is implied by schema v1.

CustomProvider.description: OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible endpoint declared by the deployment. The provider ID follows the same pattern as ModelRef.provider and gets its own MODEL_KEY_<ID> secret. Additional properties are accepted and preserved for round-trip.

CustomModel.description: Model served by a custom provider. contextWindow and maxTokens default to 128000 and 8192 when omitted. Additional properties are accepted and preserved for round-trip.

McpServerConfig.description: MCP server definition. Header values are either literal strings or env:NAME references resolved from Worker secrets; the parser preserves them verbatim and never inlines a referenced secret. Additional properties are accepted and preserved for round-trip.

headers.description: Header map. A value such as env:MCP_TOKEN is an environment reference, not a secret value; literal values are also allowed.

description.description: Human-readable summary shown to the butler.

catalogId.description: Service catalog entry that produced this server; omitted for custom URLs.

oauth.description: The server authenticates through OAuth handled by McpAuthDO; no token is stored in this document.

enabled.description: Defaults to true when omitted. A disabled server keeps its configuration and stored authorization.

approvalPolicy.description: writes: read-only tools run directly; other tools are reviewed automatically and only risky calls ask the owner. requireApproval and autoApprove take precedence.
